quotes.text: the updated messages should have been deleted from the store

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The changed client scenario updates two messages and also moves/deletes two others. Its assertion for updated-message store deletion reads _deletedItemIds.length, although the listener records updates separately in _updated. The preceding assertion already expects the two moved/deleted IDs, so this count can pass without checking the update callbacks or store invalidation named by the message. The mismatch remains in the renamed accepted test. This is a static assertion/coverage finding, not a reproduced test failure or the reported build-failure cause.
title: The EWS updated-message storage assertion reads the separate deletion callback array
